name: KHR - Arashi no Love
source: A Katekyo Hitman Reborn simulation game. The game is about Gokudera Hayato's life, where his Juudaime is far away, training with Reborn. He is uneasy living without him, but Reborn suggest Gokudera to search for love. Will Gokudera be able to find his true love? Contain YamaGoku, ShamalGoku, GokuHaru, BelGoku, MukuGoku, and DinoHiba couple. But so far, only the DEMO is released. The full version of it will be finished later.
